title: Hearty Dense Syrian Tofu Casserole
description: A rich and flavorful plant-based casserole inspired by Syrian cuisine, featuring fajita seasoning and a crispy en-croute crust. This dish is perfect for a solo dinner or a special occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat and sauté the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the fajita seasoning to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and cook until browned on all sides.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked tofu mixture, pita bread pieces, vegetable broth, nutritional yeast, salt, and black pepper, and stir until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Cover the dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30 minutes.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 20 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is heated through.
Remove the dish from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
